Object layer: all 11 pods 1/1 Running, RESTARTS 0; service checkoutservice exists (ClusterIP 10.68.113.121, 5050/TCP) with endpoints 172.20.3.231:5050 bound, and an active TCP probe to 10.68.113.121:5050 succeeded, so the missing-Service / empty-endpoints branch is excluded; namespace events surface is empty and GetAlerts reports no metric anomaly. The breakpoint is on the config-reference surface: both the checkoutservice Deployment YAML and the live pod spec carry PRODUCT_CATALOG_SERVICE_ADDR=productcatalogservice-invalid:3550, and that target does not exist (services productcatalogservice-invalid not found in namespace boutique), so every GetProduct call in the PlaceOrder orchestration ends in NXDOMAIN; the other downstream addresses (shipping, payment, email, currency, cart) are correct, which explains why only checkout is unreachable while the rest of the storefront works. Root cause: incorrect service address environment variable on checkoutservice.
